gaps.criterion: Mapping templates show version, certification and reuse count
gaps.gap: The screen renders all three - name + v<version>, a Certified/Custom badge, and 'N canonical fields, N transforms, used N times' - and the server derives the counts from sdk-import's field_map, transforms and use_count columns rather than shipping raw JSONB to the browser. What is NOT proven is that they render with real values: no LeadFlow route creates a mapping template, sdk-import returns an empty library in this environment, so the template cards never appear in a local run and the .feature scenario can only assert the section heading. The values are asserted at the payload level in tests/api_definitions/imports/center-get.json. Closing this needs either a seeded template in the environment or the Import wizard's template-authoring surface (tasks 77-80), which is the same missing write surface already recorded against task 75 AC1.
